_comment: Discriminating probe set for control-flow arms. Separate from questions.json,
which is mined from real prod history and is right for judging ANSWER QUALITY
but cannot test whether a flow made the right RETRIEVAL DECISION — every
mined question is one a real person asked a search engine, so nearly all of
`expectSearch` is my judgement, not ground truth, and it is the weakest part
of this harness. It encodes: would a competent research assistant reach for
the web here? For the `false` cases the test is whether a flow can decline —
today's prompt forbids declining outright, so baseline is expected to fail
all of them, which is the point of measuring it.
`mustMention` is a coarse groundedness check: a specific token the answer
should contain if it actually engaged with the question. Absence is a signal
to read the answer, not an automatic fail.

probes.text: What is the difference between TCP and UDP?
Explain what a closure is in JavaScript.
Why does water expand when it freezes?

probes.why: arithmetic; the calculate tool at most, never a web search

probes.text: Write a haiku about a broken printer.
probes.why: generative, no external fact exists to retrieve

probes.text: What does the acronym SOLID stand for in software design?
What is the current stable version of PostgreSQL and what changed in it?
What are the latest reported figures for global EV sales this year?
How much does a Framework Laptop 16 cost right now?
Has anything significant changed in UK right-to-repair rules recently?
Compare the Anker Prime 27650 and the Ugreen Nexode 25000 power banks on capacity, output and price.
probes.why: two named products, several attributes each; the case that should drive iteration

probes.text: Which of Caddy, Traefik and nginx has the least painful automatic HTTPS setup, and why?
probes.why: three entities, comparative judgement, current behaviour

probes.text: Is SQLite a reasonable choice for a web app with about 200 concurrent users?
probes.why: answerable from knowledge but genuinely improved by current sources; deliberately ambiguous

probes.text: Should I use tabs or spaces for indentation?
probes.why: opinion with no retrievable fact; a flow that searches this is over-retrieving

probes.text: cách khắc phục lỗi wifi tự ngắt kết nối trên windows 11
probes.why: non-English troubleshooting; the known retrieval gap, kept in deliberately

probes.text: What is systemd-resolved and why do people disable it?
probes.why: stable-ish, but the 'why people disable it' half is community opinion worth sourcing
